name: Azamuku IF
divergenceSummary: Teleported to the southern empire with Rem, Subaru makes an alternate contract with Emperor Vincent to deceive fate and outwit the Imperial throne through pure subterfuge.
headline: The Two Who Deceived Fate
description: Subaru and Emperor Vincent Vollachia cross paths in the Land of the Sword Wolves to deceive destiny in an alternate imperial confrontation.

events.name: Stranded in the Land of Sword Wolves
events.description: Subaru awakens deep in hostile imperial territory with an amnesiac Rem who distrusts him, forced to outsmart imperial hunters.

events.name: The Sovereign Pact of Mutual Deception
events.description: Subaru and Emperor Vincent agree to an alternate scheme of grand theater and disinformation to overthrow usurper Chisha Gold without bloodshed.

events.name: The Bloodless Coup of Lupugana
events.description: Through an audacious chain of bluffs, illusions, and military deception, the imperial throne is restored without a single casualty.
